integrationsCatalog.entry.magic-patterns: Connect Magic Patterns so the agent can create and refine frontend designs and prototypes with you.
integrationsCatalog.entry.webflow.detail: Connect Webflow so the agent can create and edit pages, change layouts and styles, and update CMS collections.
integrationsCatalog.entry.contentful.det: Connect Contentful so the agent can model content types, create and update entries and work with assets and locales.
integrationsCatalog.entry.sanity.details: Connect Sanity so the agent can run GROQ queries, update documents, coordinate releases and set up schemas. Comes with Sanity skills for best practices and content modeling.
integrationsCatalog.entry.storyblok.deta: Connect Storyblok with a personal access token so the agent can read and change stories, components and assets. A scoped token limits it to the spaces it needs. Comes with Storyblok skills for working through the MCP server and modeling content.
integrationsCatalog.entry.wordpress.deta: Connect WordPress.com so the agent can find and draft posts, update pages, read comments and check site stats.
integrationsCatalog.entry.netlify.detail: Connect Netlify so the agent can create sites, deploy them, manage environment variables and access controls, and read form submissions.
integrationsCatalog.entry.pulumi.details: Connect Pulumi Cloud so the agent can inspect stacks and resources, look up packages in the registry and work with deployments. Comes with Pulumi skills for best practices and Pulumi ESC.
integrationsCatalog.entry.upsun.details: Connect Upsun so the agent can manage projects and preview environments, follow deployments and read logs.
integrationsCatalog.entry.qovery.details: Connect Qovery so the agent can create and manage environments, deploy services and check their status in your cloud.
integrationsCatalog.entry.tigris.details: Connect Tigris so the agent can create buckets and list, read and upload objects in S3-compatible storage.
integrationsCatalog.entry.semaphore.deta: Connect Semaphore so the agent can look at pipelines and workflows, read job logs and find out why a build failed.
integrationsCatalog.entry.buddy.details: Connect Buddy so the agent can run and inspect pipelines, work with sandboxes and manage projects.
integrationsCatalog.entry.tuist.details: Connect Tuist so the agent can read build and test insights, find flaky tests and look up previews of iOS and macOS apps.
integrationsCatalog.entry.vantage.detail: Connect Vantage so the agent can query your cloud spend across providers, break it down and find ways to save.
integrationsCatalog.entry.prisma.details: Connect Prisma so the agent can create Prisma Postgres databases, run migrations and query data.
integrationsCatalog.entry.planetscale.de: Connect PlanetScale so the agent can look at databases and branches, read schemas and query performance data from Insights.
integrationsCatalog.entry.upstash.detail: Connect Upstash so the agent can create and inspect Redis and Vector databases, run commands and manage QStash.
integrationsCatalog.entry.turso.details: Connect Turso so the agent can create databases and groups and run SQL against your Turso databases.
integrationsCatalog.entry.cockroachdb.de: Connect CockroachDB Cloud so the agent can inspect clusters, read schemas and run SQL.
integrationsCatalog.entry.motherduck.det: Connect MotherDuck so the agent can explore databases, run DuckDB SQL and build shareable answers from your data. Comes with MotherDuck skills for exploring data, writing DuckDB SQL and running queries.
integrationsCatalog.entry.pg-aiguide.det: Give the agent PostgreSQL documentation and Postgres skills from Tiger Data, so the SQL and schemas it writes follow good practice. Needs no account.
integrationsCatalog.entry.amplitude.deta: Connect Amplitude so the agent can search charts and dashboards, query events and read experiment results. Comes with Amplitude skills for analyzing dashboards and experiments, checking live data and writing a weekly brief.
integrationsCatalog.entry.chartmogul.det: Connect ChartMogul so the agent can read MRR, churn and other subscription metrics, and look up customers.
integrationsCatalog.entry.thoughtspot.de: Connect ThoughtSpot so the agent can ask Spotter questions about your data and get answers you can check.
integrationsCatalog.entry.airbyte.detail: Connect Airbyte so the agent can read and act on data in the business systems you have connected to Airbyte.
integrationsCatalog.entry.axiom.details: Connect Axiom so the agent can run APL queries over your logs and events and look at monitors and dashboards.
integrationsCatalog.entry.honeycomb.deta: Connect Honeycomb so the agent can query traces and events from OpenTelemetry and other sources and dig into slow or failing requests. Comes with Honeycomb skills for investigating production issues and for SLOs and triggers.
integrationsCatalog.entry.new-relic.deta: Connect New Relic so the agent can run NRQL queries, look at entities and alerts, and investigate incidents. Comes with New Relic skills for root-causing APM errors, writing NRQL and finding traces.
integrationsCatalog.entry.better-stack.d: Connect Better Stack so the agent can check monitors and incidents, query logs and look at errors.
integrationsCatalog.entry.rootly.details: Connect Rootly so the agent can look up incidents and who is on call, update incidents and help with retrospectives.
integrationsCatalog.entry.groundcover.de: Connect groundcover so the agent can query logs, traces and metrics collected from your Kubernetes clusters.
integrationsCatalog.entry.signoz.details: Connect SigNoz Cloud so the agent can query traces, logs and metrics and look at alerts and dashboards. Comes with SigNoz skills for investigating alerts, writing queries and building dashboards.
integrationsCatalog.entry.openobserve.de: Connect OpenObserve Cloud so the agent can search logs, metrics and traces with SQL and PromQL.
integrationsCatalog.entry.logrocket.deta: Connect LogRocket so the agent can look into user sessions, errors and performance issues in your web and mobile apps.
integrationsCatalog.entry.uptimerobot.de: Connect UptimeRobot so the agent can list monitors, read uptime and incidents and manage status pages. Comes with UptimeRobot skills for SLA reports and a quick health summary.
integrationsCatalog.entry.onlineornot.de: Connect OnlineOrNot so the agent can look at uptime and browser checks, scheduled job heartbeats and status pages.
integrationsCatalog.entry.openstatus.det: Connect OpenStatus so the agent can read monitor results from several regions and post incidents and maintenance to status pages.
integrationsCatalog.entry.hyperping.deta: Connect Hyperping with a project API key so the agent can read monitors, outages and their timelines, uptime and on-call schedules.
integrationsCatalog.entry.oneuptime.deta: Connect OneUptime with a project API key so the agent can work with monitors, incidents, alerts, status pages and telemetry. A read-only key is enough for looking around.
integrationsCatalog.entry.firecrawl.deta: Connect Firecrawl so the agent can search the web, scrape pages into clean Markdown, crawl sites and parse documents. Comes with Firecrawl skills for cited deep-research reports, literature reviews, competitor tracking and SEO audits.
integrationsCatalog.entry.tavily.details: Connect Tavily so the agent can search the web, extract content from pages and run research on live data.
integrationsCatalog.entry.jina.details: Give the agent Jina AI tools for reading web pages and PDFs, web and arXiv search, screenshots and reranking. Works without a key within the free limit; add an API key for more.
integrationsCatalog.entry.parallel.detai: Give the agent Parallel web search, which returns excerpts that usually answer the question, plus page fetching. Needs no account.
integrationsCatalog.entry.perplexity.det: Connect Perplexity so the agent can ask it questions and get web-grounded answers with their sources.
integrationsCatalog.entry.browserbase.de: Connect Browserbase with an API key so the agent can open a cloud browser, navigate, act on pages and extract data.
integrationsCatalog.entry.browser-use.de: Connect Browser Use with an API key so the agent can hand a task to a cloud browser agent and follow its progress.
integrationsCatalog.entry.kernel.details: Connect Kernel so the agent can start isolated cloud browsers, control them and use saved profiles.
integrationsCatalog.entry.braintrust.det: Connect Braintrust so the agent can read production traces, work with datasets and run and compare evaluations.
integrationsCatalog.entry.logfire.detail: Connect Logfire so the agent can query traces and logs with SQL and look at dashboards and alerts. This entry uses the US region. Comes with the Logfire query skill.
integrationsCatalog.entry.chroma-package: Connect Chroma Package Search with an API key so the agent can grep and read the source of npm, PyPI, crates and other packages your code depends on.
integrationsCatalog.entry.mem0.details: Connect Mem0 so the agent can store, search and update memories that carry over between sessions.
integrationsCatalog.entry.attio.details: Connect Attio so the agent can look up companies and people, log notes from calls, track deals and create follow-up tasks.
integrationsCatalog.entry.close.details: Connect Close so the agent can search leads and contacts, review activity and update opportunities in your sales pipeline.
integrationsCatalog.entry.day-ai.details: Connect Day AI so the agent can draw on the CRM records Day AI builds from your emails, chats and meetings.
integrationsCatalog.entry.lightfield.det: Connect Lightfield so the agent can read customer records and interactions it has captured and help with sales follow-ups.
integrationsCatalog.entry.plain.details: Connect Plain so the agent can read and reply to support threads, look up customers and work with help center content.
integrationsCatalog.entry.pylon.details: Connect Pylon so the agent can search, update and resolve customer issues in your support queue.
integrationsCatalog.entry.unthread.detai: Connect Unthread so the agent can search support conversations, watch SLAs and analyze helpdesk metrics.
integrationsCatalog.entry.intercom.detai: Connect Intercom so the agent can search customer conversations, tickets and user data, for example to spot bugs or find feedback. Comes with Intercom skills for analyzing conversations and building a full customer view.
integrationsCatalog.entry.superhuman.det: Connect Superhuman Mail so the agent can search your inbox, draft replies in your voice, set reminders and schedule meetings. Comes with Superhuman skills for a morning briefing, an end-of-day wrap-up and scheduling meetings.
integrationsCatalog.entry.ramp.details: Connect Ramp for read-only access to transactions, reimbursements, bills, cards and vendors, so the agent can analyze company spend.
integrationsCatalog.entry.brex.details: Connect Brex so the agent can query expenses, check policy and compliance and answer spend questions, within your Brex permissions.
integrationsCatalog.entry.mercury.detail: Connect Mercury so the agent can check balances, search and chart transactions and download statements.
integrationsCatalog.entry.gusto.details: Connect Gusto so the agent can answer questions about payroll and your team and build reports from them.
integrationsCatalog.entry.remote.details: Connect Remote so the agent can look up employees, payroll, time off and expenses for your global team. Comes with the Remote skill for payroll and payslips.
integrationsCatalog.entry.ashby.details: Connect Ashby so the agent can look up candidates and jobs, review interview feedback and read recruiting analytics.
integrationsCatalog.entry.pandadoc.detai: Connect PandaDoc so the agent can create documents from templates, send them for signature and track their status.
integrationsCatalog.entry.make.details: Connect Make so the agent can run scenarios and view or change them along with their connections, webhooks and data stores. Comes with Make skills for exploring, building and running scenarios.
integrationsCatalog.entry.ifttt.details: Connect IFTTT so the agent can run actions across more than a thousand services and create or update Applets.
integrationsCatalog.entry.windmill.detai: Connect Windmill so the agent can run your scripts and flows and work with the resources in your workspace.
integrationsCatalog.entry.resource-monit: Watch CPU and memory of your machine, OpenChamber and dev servers

Install the Resource Monitor extension for a panel with live CPU and memory of your machine, OpenChamber, OpenCode and the dev servers they started, and a Stop button for runaway commands. Works on web and desktop.
integrationsCatalog.entry.opencode-claud: Use your Claude Pro or Max plan through the Claude Code CLI

Install the plugin to get a Claude Code provider in OpenCode. Requests run through the official Claude Agent SDK and the claude CLI on your machine, so no API key is needed; usage counts against your Claude plan limits.
integrationsCatalog.entry.opencode-searc: Web search with SearXNG, Brave Search, Kagi, Perplexity, Linkup and Serper

Adds six providers to OpenCode's built-in web search: your own SearXNG server, Brave Search, Kagi, Perplexity Search, Linkup and Serper. After installing, add a key, or the address of your SearXNG server, in Settings → Web search, and the provider joins the search choices.
